messages:
amal: Heads-up — I prototyped a small extension to deploy-bot to improve pinning/rollback ergonomics and to emit a release-note stub. Looking for quick feedback before I open a PR.

jordyn: nice. short summary of UX changes?

amal: TL;DR: new commands + templates
- `deploy-bot propose-pin <service> <image>` -> posts prefilled pin PR body + rollout plan
- `deploy-bot release-stub <service> [--canary]` -> generates a markdown release-note snippet
- `deploy-bot set-safety <service> --rollback-rule "metric:threshold:window"` -> attach heuristics for auto-alert + suggested rollback

kai: can we make the rollback rules reusable across services? e.g., a `safety-profile:low-latency` that multiple teams can reference

amal: yes — plan is to support a named profile and per-deploy overrides. profiles live in a small yaml under infra/deploy/safety_profiles.yaml

marcos: quick example of a generated release stub?

amal: paste below
```
## Release notes (auto-generated)
Service: payments
Image: redwood/payments:v3.2.0
Canary: enabled (5% -> 25% -> 100%)
Rollout window: 02:00-05:00 UTC
Safety profile: low-latency
Key changes:
- Fix race in token caching reducing tail latency for checkout flows
- Upgrade libgrpc to v1.12

Canary checks:
- 5xx rate <= 0.05%
- p95 latency delta <= +20ms
- error budget burn < 10% / 15m

Release owner: @jordyn
```

jordyn: love that. Could the stub include a one-line revert command? saves mental context.

amal: yep — adding `rollback_hint: deploy revert --service payments --to image_tag` in the stub.

deploy-bot: I can surface that. Example command: `/deploy start --service payments --image redwood/payments:v3.2.0 --pin --canary 5,25,100 --window 0200-0500 --safety-profile low-latency`

kai: can deploy-bot also generate a release PR with the pinned image and changelog link? fewer manual steps.

amal: prototype does that: bot opens a PR in the infra repo with
- pins
- rollout config yaml
- a release note draft linked to the PR
we attach the canary config as `deployments/payments-canary.yaml`

marcos: one concern: PR noise. If teams push fast we might get many small PRs. Can we batch pins per release window?

amal: yes — bot has `--group-by-window` which will aggregate pins for a given change window and open a single PR per window. Default is off.

jordyn: what about rollbacks: automatic vs manual? We need guardrails so SRE ops aren't paged for every blip.

amal: proposal: three modes per service: `manual`, `alert-only`, `auto-rollback`. Default `alert-only`. `auto-rollback` only allowed if service has runbook attached and owner approved via `deploy-bot approve-auto-rollback payments`.

kai: what signals do we use? example config?

amal: example YAML schema in the prototype
```
service: payments
safety_profile: low-latency
signals:
  - name: 5xx_rate
    source: datadog/metric
    threshold: 0.0005   # 0.05%
    window: 5m
    action: alert
  - name: p95_latency_delta
    source: datadog/metric
    threshold: 0.02   # 20% increase
    window: 10m
    action: rollback_if_auto
```

sre-bot: note: any `rollback_if_auto` action will require a cooldown of 10 minutes and a secondary confirmation if the rollback would affect multiple regions.

camel: small ask: can the template include a release-note key called `impact` (user-visible impact) — product folks want that in every release.

amal: added `impact` field to the stub and included it in the PR body.

jordyn: minor: can we make pin proposals show delta of image layers for quick size/cost check?

amal: good idea. proto computes `image_diff` via `skopeo inspect` and shows 
```
+ 2 new layers
+ ~12MB added
```

marcos: timeline? when will you open the PR?

amal: I want to iterate one more day based on this thread. Will open draft PR by `1880012400` and leave it as `deploy-bot draft` until we get a quick design + SRE sign-off.

kai: happy to review the safety profile YAML and the approve flow.

jordyn: I'll review the release stub content. also can we add a `--release-notes-url` flag so teams can link external changelogs.

amal: added. thanks everyone — will post PR and drop a follow-up here. :rocket:

deploy-bot: draft PR created: infra/ops#412 — published as `WIP: pin/payments v3.2.0 + canary`

deploy-bot: automation note: `approve-auto-rollback` requires `@sre-team` or `@platform` group approval (org policy)

marcos: sweet. please include a short HOWTO in docs/devex/deploy-bot.md so on-call knows the flow.

amal: will do. end of thread.
